usage: 橘子 is a noun used to refer to the fruit tangerine.
It can be used as the subject or object of a sentence.
You can describe the tangerine with adjectives to talk about its taste or appearance.
橘子 is countable, so you can use numbers or measure words before it.
It is often used in everyday conversations when talking about fruits or snacks.
